content.text: /ext:medcp For bronchiolitis, select one supportive care medication and show how often it appears in pediatric charts.
I'll first check what the knowledge graph and clinical tables offer, then find a supportive care medication for bronchiolitis and count its pediatric chart occurrences.

This is an OMOP CDM database. Supportive care for bronchiolitis is largely non-pharmacologic (oxygen, fluids), but a commonly used supportive medication is **albuterol** (a bronchodilator trialed for symptom relief). Let me find its concept and count occurrences in pediatric charts (age < 18 at drug exposure).

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id = 'Drug'
  AND standard_concept = 'S'
  AND concept_class_id = 'Ingredient'
  AND LOWER(concept_name) IN ('albuterol','salbutamol','epinephrine','dexamethasone','ipratropium')
ORDER BY concept_name

content.text: Now let me count how often albuterol (the supportive bronchodilator) appears in pediatric charts — patients under 18 at the time of the drug exposure. I'll count via the ingredient using `concept_ancestor` so all albuterol drug products are included.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS albuterol_exposure_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS distinct_pediatric_patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
 AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 1154343  -- albuterol ingredient
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = de.person_id
WHERE (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM de.drug_exposure_start_date) - p.year_of_birth) < 18

content.text: SQL Server backend — I'll use `DATEPART`/`YEAR` instead of `EXTRACT`.

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS albuterol_exposure_rows,
  COUNT(DISTINCT de.person_id) AS distinct_pediatric_patients
FROM omop.drug_exposure de
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON ca.descendant_concept_id = de.drug_concept_id
 AND ca.ancestor_concept_id = 1154343
JOIN omop.person p ON p.person_id = de.person_id
WHERE (YEAR(de.drug_exposure_start_date) - p.year_of_birth) < 18

content.text:
**Supportive care medication: albuterol** (inhaled bronchodilator, commonly trialed for symptom relief in bronchiolitis).

Occurrences in pediatric charts (age < 18 at exposure), counting all albuterol products via the RxNorm ingredient:

| Metric | Count |
|---|---|
| Albuterol exposure records | 1,459,569 |
| Distinct pediatric patients | 63,078 |

Note: this counts pediatric albuterol use overall, not restricted to bronchiolitis encounters. Clinically, guidelines (AAP) do **not** recommend routine bronchodilators for bronchiolitis — true supportive care is mainly oxygen/hydration — but albuterol is the pharmacologic agent most often given.
